site.title: Przemysław Kępka - PK Data Solutions

hero.description: I make business and IT worlds come together by developing full-stack data solutions:
hero.point1: From raw data to websites, dashboards and insights
hero.point2: From small automation scripts to fully-fledged web applications
hero.point3: From manual processes to automated workflows that save dozens of hours

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Bridging the worlds of business and IT
about.background: With a finance background, I've evolved into a data specialist with 7+ years of experience across different data and systems positions. I combine business acumen with technical expertise to deliver end-to-end solutions.
about.timeSavedDesc: On a single automated process, saving dozens of hours weekly
about.value1: I ask 'why' before 'how' - business goals drive technical decisions
about.value2: I speak both languages - communicating seamlessly with both stakeholders and developers
about.value3: I own the full picture - from database to dashboard, from gathering requirements to a deployed solution
about.industriesHint: Click an industry to see related projects
about.industriesStatement: Data patterns transfer across industries - whether it's financial transactions, IoT sensors, or social media analytics. But context matters: I always work closely with domain experts to understand the specific business needs behind every technical solution.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Full-Stack Data Solutions Pipeline
services.fullStack: I handle the entire process end-to-end
services.flexible: But also tackle specific parts based on your needs
services.flexible2: And I work with both small businesses and big enterprises
services.pipelineSubtitle: From first conversation to a deployed solution
services.pipelineStep1Desc: We discuss your challenges, goals, and current setup to understand what success looks like.
services.pipelineStep2Desc: I analyze opportunities and present a clear action plan with scope and timeline.
services.pipelineStep3Desc: Iterative building with regular check-ins to ensure we're on track.
services.pipelineStep4Desc: Handoff with documentation and support to ensure smooth adoption.
